tools.name: check_task_leakage
tools.description: Check whether coding tasks from SWE-bench-style benchmarks leaked their fix. Pass one instance ID for the full evidence, or up to 50 IDs in the queries field, as a JSON array of strings or one string separated by commas, spaces or new lines (a results file's task list), to get back which are flagged

tools.name: benchmark_leakage_summary
tools.description: How leaky is a coding benchmark? Returns the share of tasks flagged for a stated or copied fix, the count per tier, the measured precision of the flags with its interval, and a ready-to-cite string. Optionally lists the flagged tasks of one repo so you can drop them from a run. Also returns auditYou

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_task_leakage · Private data: check_task_leakage · Public sink: benchmark_leakage_summary · Destructive: benchmark_leakage_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_task_leakage · Private data: check_task_leakage · Public sink: benchmark_leakage_summary · Destructive: benchmark_leakage_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
